notes.title: 🧬 BIG LANGUAGE AND TECHNICAL UPDATE 🔧
notes.content:
[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504526/902ab2043e1945987a0739b599cdbb1e126cad2c.gif[/img][/h1]

This update is more than just fixes!
It's opening up to players from all over the world!

[h3]🌍 Added full support for 12 languages:[/h3]
Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, German, Polish, Ukrainian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Italian

[h3]🔧 Optimization[/h3] - the game runs smoother than ever.
[h3]🧱 Collisions[/h3] - collision detection and environmental physics have been improved, eliminating known character-blocking bugs.
[h3]🕹️ Redesigned controls[/h3] - for maximum responsiveness and fluidity. Every action of the player translates into an immediate and precise response of the character.
